Frequently asked questions

What does Wild Collective do?

Wild Collective is a custom merchandise and corporate gifting manufacturer based in Mysuru, Karnataka, India. We make custom printed and embroidered T-shirts, polo T-shirts, hoodies, caps, mugs, bottles, diaries, pens, bags, keychains, badges and curated corporate gift sets for businesses, institutions, events and individuals.

Do you take orders from outside India?

Yes. Wild Collective works with businesses in India and internationally. Shipping method, courier cost, import duties and lead time are confirmed with each quotation on WhatsApp or email.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Minimum quantities depend on the product and customization. Some items such as diaries start from 10 pieces; keychains and metal pens from 50; badges and stickers from 50–100; satin keychains from 500. Share your requirement and we will confirm the MOQ.

How much do custom T-shirts cost?

Custom round neck T-shirts start from ₹75, collar (polo) T-shirts from ₹150, sweatshirts from ₹400 and hoodies from ₹450 per piece. The final price depends on fabric, print or embroidery method, number of colours and quantity.

How do I get a quotation?

Choose your products, then send the quantity and branding requirement on WhatsApp (+91 99454 21777) or email contact@wildcollective.store. The Wild Collective team confirms pricing, options and order details directly.

Which branding methods do you offer?

Screen printing, DTF and digital printing, embroidery, UV printing, laser engraving and embossing, chosen according to the product, fabric, artwork and finish you want.
